questions.question: An input drift alert fired before new labels arrived. What follows?
options: Retrain and automatically replace the active model.
Investigate the change and gather quality evidence before choosing a response.
Declare accuracy has decreased by the drift score.
questions.explanation: MLOps connects data validation, training, evaluation, packaging, delivery and monitoring. Continuous integration tests code and contracts; model promotion additionally needs data and quality evidence. Automatic retraining is a policy decision, not the inevitable response to any drift alert.
